evidence: Adds src/index/txoscriptindex.cpp, src/index/txoscriptindex.h, src/index/txoscriptindex_key.h, and associated tests under src/test/.
rationale: Introduces txoscriptindex, an optional index under src/index/ providing compact script pubkey history. It delivers a long-sought index capability attempted across five PRs since 2013, with low storage overhead (~54 GB) and pruned-node compatibility.
